title: Thai Chicken and Tom Kha Soup
description: A low-carb, keto-friendly version of the popular Thai soup.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the tom kha paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and chili flakes.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the soup has thickened slightly.
Stir in the lime juice and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or basil if desired.
